sunoPrompt: Driving organic funk-rock, deep elastic bass, dry live drums, clipped wah guitar, clavinet and earthy hand percussion. Strong rhythmic sung hook, forward movement and long developing instrumental passages, human imperfect ensemble. Approximately 132 BPM. Full-length song around 4 minutes. Let the band develop spacious instrumental passages and return to the central sung refrain across the song. Keep clear natural Polish phrasing and leave breath between long lines.

że nie ma w nim miejsca na zwyczajny gorszy dzień.
